summary: The diff implements 13 tool components (6 calculators, 3 converters, 4 text-tools) with complete ToolPageTemplate integration, metadata entries, and routing. However, critical requirements are missing: no visible button borders were added (REQ-160), no evidence of route fixes in App.tsx (REQ-161), no dropdown background fixes for converters (REQ-167, REQ-168), and no gradient image generation/verification (REQ-175).

missing_requirements.requirement: Add visible borders to all tool action buttons (Calculate, Convert, Generate, Submit, Analyze, Reset, Clear) across calculators, converters, and text-tools categories using OKLCH color system variables with proper contrast in both light and dark themes.
missing_requirements.reason: The diff shows button components in tool files but provides no evidence of border styling changes. The index.css file was modified with new border color variables (--border: oklch(0.85 0.01 264) in light, oklch(0.35 0.01 264) in dark), but no button-specific border classes or styles were added to make borders visible on action buttons.

missing_requirements.requirement: Fix tool routing issues for all tools in calculators, converters, and text-tools categories. Verify route definitions in frontend/src/App.tsx use the correct /tools/{category}/{tool-slug} URL pattern with lazy-loaded component imports.
missing_requirements.reason: App.tsx diff summary mentions TanStack Router configuration including all tool routes but the actual file content is truncated and does not show route definitions for the 13 tools. Cannot verify that routes match the /tools/{category}/{tool-slug} pattern or that lazy-loaded imports are correctly configured.

Save gradient images to frontend/public/assets/generated/ with filenames following pattern tool-[slug]-hero-gradient.dim_1200x400.png. Regenerate any gray or low-contrast gradients with vibrant alternatives.
